Install qwen-code on Omarchy

Open-source AI agent for the terminal, optimized for Qwen-Coder

The official repository lists this package in Utilities. It was added on 2026-11-24.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add qwen-code
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.28.4-1:
    pacman -Qi qwen-code

Open and use qwen-code

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql qwen-code

Frequently asked questions

How do I install qwen-code on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add qwen-code. The download is 28 MB and it takes 114.6 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is qwen-code free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed Apache-2.0.

How do I uninstall qwen-code?

Run omarchy pkg drop qwen-code. It removes the package from your system.

What does qwen-code depend on?

The package declares 3 dependencies: nodejs, glibc, gcc-libs. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is qwen-code in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as qwen-code (version 0.28.4-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. QwenLM makes it. Project site: https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code.
